title: Publish the public content-free playtest report event (NIP-XP kind 3197) when a report is sent
body:
Follow-up to epic #9888 and #9885. NIP-XP's `playtest` rule accepts a contribution only when the tester signed a public, content-free playtest report (kind `3197`, renumbered from `3195` in #9900) that commits to the private report's digest. The app seals the private report to the triage key (NIP-17) but never publishes the `3197`, so no report can back a playtest award.

Scope: when a report is sent, the app also signs a `3197` with the tester's Verse world key (`nostr::xp::playtest::playtest_report`: build, platform, report kind, the SHA-256 of the NIP-17 rumor's exact content, no text) and publishes it to the OpenAgents relay; My reports shows whether it was published, and a failure is retried with the report. The triage inbox records the digest so a triager can find the matching public event.

Acceptance: the published event's digest equals the digest of the rumor the triage key opens; the event parses under `parse_playtest_report` and carries no report text; nothing is published while the build has no triage key; tests; INVARIANTS row updated.
